source: Ticket #18 venue with integration b9552af (records and detailed Kart)
limitations: Single high-end laptop; not evidence for all everyday laptops.
Ten-second public-input driving samples, not the later full twelve-lap integration run.
Near-120 FPS results are display-refresh-limited; settings cost differences are verified by drawing buffer and shadow configuration, not noisy FPS ordering.
